definitions.name: Weak Executive Sponsorship
definitions.description: Sponsors are not converting intent into decisions, visibility or outcome ownership.
definitions.rationale: Two or more sponsorship deficits across decision making, reporting, outcomes or benefits.

definitions.name: Effective Executive Sponsorship
definitions.description: Sponsors are actively steering decisions, visibility and outcomes.
definitions.rationale: Two or more sponsorship strengths across decision making, reporting and outcomes.

definitions.name: Governance Theatre
definitions.description: Governance forums are producing reporting activity without assurance value.
definitions.rationale: Two or more deficits across reporting, compliance and risk governance.

definitions.name: Assurance Gap
definitions.description: Compliance obligations are not backed by dependable delivery assurance.
definitions.rationale: Compliance weakness combined with weak automated testing.

definitions.name: Slow Decision Making
definitions.description: Decisions are escalating late and dependencies stall waiting for direction.
definitions.rationale: Weak decision ownership together with unmanaged cross-team dependencies.

definitions.name: Clear Decision Ownership
definitions.description: Decision rights are explicit and dependencies are resolved without escalation.
definitions.rationale: Decision-making and dependency strengths observed together.

definitions.name: Benefits Not Tracked
definitions.description: Investment is proceeding without measured benefit realisation.
definitions.rationale: Benefits tracking weakness alongside weak outcome ownership.

definitions.name: Unreliable Delivery Planning
definitions.description: Plans cannot be trusted because flow is unconstrained and unmeasured.
definitions.rationale: Two or more deficits across work in progress, cycle time and unplanned work.

definitions.name: Delivery Risk Blind Spots
definitions.description: Material delivery risk is accumulating without sponsor visibility.
definitions.rationale: Weak risk governance combined with technical debt or unplanned work pressure.

definitions.name: Engineering Fragility
definitions.description: The delivery system cannot release change safely or repeatably.
definitions.rationale: Two or more deficits across continuous integration, automated testing and deployment.

definitions.name: Delivery Leadership Overload
definitions.description: Delivery leadership is absorbing demand instead of shaping it.
definitions.rationale: Two or more deficits across work in progress, unplanned work and dependencies.

definitions.name: Mature Delivery Leadership
definitions.description: Delivery leadership protects focus and sustains a dependable release cadence.
definitions.rationale: Two or more strengths across work in progress, cycle time and deployment.

definitions.name: Ineffective Portfolio Reporting
definitions.description: Portfolio reporting does not reflect real delivery performance.
definitions.rationale: Reporting weakness combined with unmeasured cycle time.

definitions.name: Change Adoption Risk
definitions.description: Change is being delivered without evidence that users are adopting it.
definitions.rationale: Weak feedback loops combined with weak outcome-based prioritisation.

definitions.name: Incomplete Sponsorship Evidence
definitions.description: Too much of the sponsorship picture is unknown for confident reasoning.
definitions.rationale: Three or more questions were left unanswered.
